name: Syside Automator
description: A Python library and command-line toolkit for programmatic SysML v2 model editing, evaluation, validation, diagram and CSV export, reporting, and CI/CD automation.
editorialNote: Added from NeoMBSE's 2026-10-23 coverage audit. This automation product is recorded separately from the Syside modeling editor.

simulation.note: Verified for model evaluation and simulation through Python automation.

classificationNotes: ReqIF import/export is not counted as XMI model exchange.
Python APIs for automation are not automatically equivalent to the OMG Systems Modeling API and Services specification.
